purpose: Propose task records that may be removed from active task views after the workshop. This is a review list only; no tracker records were changed.
decision_rule: Prefer close or archive for obsolete one-off tasks so the work history remains available. Delete only records explicitly labeled as duplicates after confirming the retained counterpart.

removal_candidates.title: Repeated copies of the same workshop task in separate trackers
removal_candidates.candidate_action: Consolidate only after selecting one system of record; archive redundant copies in other trackers while preserving comments, attachments, and links.
removal_candidates.reason: Local task-tracker exports and live searches show matching tasks copied among Notion, Todoist, monday.com, Asana, Linear, Dart, and ClickUp, with inconsistent completion states. No single canonical task tracker is established by the evidence reviewed.

limitations: Google Tasks could not be searched because Google authorization was requested.
ClickUp's connected workspaces were not all fully searched because the tool required explicit workspace selection.
monday.com search returned a maximum of 20 matches, so the item search may omit additional records.
Some cross-tracker records have conflicting statuses; recommendations to close or archive require checking actual completion and any unique notes.
